market_view: VIX at 15.29 down 4.5% intraday, indices modestly green, but QQQ still -2.7% on the week. The 690/681p hard-stop breach was confirmed multiple cycles ago and the rules-based exit obligation stands regardless of intraday drift.

QQQ 690/681p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.69 is 1.64x the 1.03 credit — hard stop threshold is 1.5x (1.545). This breach has now persisted across multiple cycles with the loss worsening, not improving. No intraday green justifies holding a rules-violation.

QQQ 677/668p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.12 is now above the 1.07 credit entry (losing), and closing the 690/681p does not resolve the unacceptable QQQ concentration — two put verticals on the same underlying with 27 DTE is a single correlated risk, not two positions.

SLV 61.5/60.5p.reasoning: Mid-cost 0.525 is essentially flat to the 0.55 credit, short strike 2.1% OTM, uncorrelated to QQQ, 131 DTE means no time pressure — nothing to manage.
